text: - `resolve_program` returns `Result<PathBuf, AgentError>` in `viola_agent_claude` and in the root wrapper `src/run/mod.rs`, its refusals `AgentError::BatchScriptChild` and `AgentError::ProgramNotFound`, each a fixed message; `src/cmd/revive.rs`'s private `Refusal` is another type.

text: - `tests/contract_error_bodies.rs`, carrying `andromeda:walks-tree`, enumerates every error body with its writer and witness (`CLI_DOCUMENTS`, `MCP_RESULTS`, `CHANNEL_FAULTS`, with `NOT_ERROR_BODIES` and `PLUMBING` the named exclusions); `product_error_writers_are_each_named` fails on an unnamed product error writer and `thiserror_messages_interpolate_nothing` on an interpolating `thiserror` message.

text: - A `diagnostics/` folder, role file or detail file that fails `strict::check_diagnostics` (a symbolic link, or a mode or grant another user may use) is a failed open, checked before anything is narrowed: the role writer ends at `std::io::sink` and the detail line is dropped.
